description: This file defines the ChainedFastBackendFactory class, which implements a cache backend factory for Drupal, creating chained cache backends that combine fast and consistent cache backends based on configuration and environment conditions.

classes.name: ChainedFastBackendFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating chained fast cache backends in Drupal, selecting between fast and consistent backends based on environment and configuration.

methods.name: setContainer
methods.description: Sets the service container for dependency injection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the factory, determining default cache backends based on settings and environment.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a cache backend for a specified cache bin, using chained backends if applicable.
